description: Withdrawals are closed while Obento is paused, so this returns an error. Builds the two calls that withdraw from Obento: approve the gateway to take the obUSD, then redeem with a 0.5% minimum out and partner ID 2. Leave out the amount to withdraw everything. Says whether the USDC arrives at once or on Autopilot's next pass. Sends nothing itself.

address.description: The address that holds the obUSD

amount.description: USDC to withdraw, in dollars; leave out to withdraw everything

receiver.description: Where the USDC goes; the address itself if left out
